text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: This monster is quite strong...! I can't read its movements because it's wildly flaying around in its anger!
text_block_list.orig_text:
この魔物、
強いわ……！
怒りに任せて捨て身でくるぶん、
動きが読めないっ！

text_block_list.name: Monster
text_block_list.text: ...GUOOOH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: ...! Wha... my leg! KYAAAAAAAAAHHH!?
text_block_list.orig_text:
っ！　
何っ……
足が──！
きゃああああっ！？

text_block_list.name: Pecorine
text_block_list.text: Aaah! This is bad! Sheffy-chan's been grabbed by those slimy tentacles~!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ああっ！　
大変です！
シェフィちゃんがにゅるにゅるタコ足の餌食に～っ！！

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: EEK! WHAT IS THIS?! D-DISGUSTING!!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
きゃっ！　
なにこれ！？
き、
気持ち悪～いっ！！

text_block_list.name: The Three
text_block_list.text: *Shiver*~
text_block_list.orig_text: ぞわ～～～

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: STOP SHIVERING AND HELP MEEEEEE! NO...!? It's getting really slimyyyy!!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
引いてないで助けて～～～っ！
いやっ……！？　
すっごくにゅるにゅるしてくるぅ～～～っ！

text_block_list.text: Hyaaaaan!
text_block_list.orig_text: ひゃぁ～～～んっ！

text_block_list.name: Pecorine
text_block_list.text: Huh? That scream just now was...
text_block_list.orig_text:
あれ？　
今の悲鳴って……

text_block_list.name: Kazumasa
text_block_list.text: HELP MEEEEEEE!!!
text_block_list.orig_text: 助けて～～～っ！！

text_block_list.name: Pecorine
text_block_list.text: Kazumasa-san?!
text_block_list.orig_text: カズマサさんっ！？

text_block_list.name: Kazumasa
text_block_list.text: Oooh?! Watch out, you lot!! This is the Tentapus, a beast that's lurked in underwater ruins since ancient times, ravaging the seas! Commonly known as the "Eight-Legged Evil" ...Hyaun!
text_block_list.orig_text:
おおっ！？　
おまえら、
気を付けろっ！！
こいつは昔から海底遺跡に潜み、
大海を荒らすテンタパス！
通称『八ツ足の悪……
ひゃうんっ！

text_block_list.name: Kazumasa
text_block_list.text: Do you have any idea how many members of the Margen Coast fishing guild have fallen vict-... Ahhhn! Just like this... Aaaaahn!
text_block_list.orig_text:
マルジェン海岸の漁協組合の連中が、
何人こいつの犠せ……
あふんっ！　
になったこと……
ああぁ～んっ！

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: I have no idea of whatever he's talking about... More importantly, what should we do...?! At this rate, neither Sheffy nor that old man will be rescued!
text_block_list.orig_text:
全然何言ってるか分かんないわ……
それより、
どうしよう……！？
このままじゃシェフィもおっさんも助けらんない！

text_block_list.name: Pecorine
text_block_list.text: How about we roast it just like last time using your magic, Kyaru-chan? That way we can both defeat and eat it later!
text_block_list.orig_text:
前回倒した時と同じように、
キャルちゃんの魔法で焼いて、
わたしが食べちゃうのはどうでしょうか？

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: It seems to have learned its lesson from last time... See? It's using them as shields. One wrong move, and we'll roast those two instead of the monster.
text_block_list.orig_text:
それが
あっちも学習しているみたいでね……
ほら。
シェフィたちをうまく盾にしようとしてる。
下手したら魔物じゃなくて
あの二人が丸焦げになるわ。

text_block_list.name: Kokkoro
text_block_list.text: This is a problem... First, I would prefer to rescue those two... Oh my?
text_block_list.orig_text:
困りましたね……
まずはお二人を救出したいところですが……
おや？

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: *gasp gasp*
text_block_list.orig_text: ザアアアアアアアッ──

text_block_list.name: Pecorine
text_block_list.text: R-Rain? Why is it raining inside of this "Great God's" stomach?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ、
雨っ？
どうして巨神のおなかの中に、
雨が降ってるんですか！？

text_block_list.name: Monster
text_block_list.text: ...! Gyaaaaah!
text_block_list.orig_text:
…………！
──ギャオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: Wait, that thing... it's in pain?! Could it be it doesn't like rain...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
なんかあいつ、
苦しんでるわよっ！？
雨が苦手なのかしら……？

text_block_list.name: Kazumasa
text_block_list.text: Yeah, that's exactly it! Octopuses really hate fresh water! This is a godsend!
text_block_list.orig_text:
おう、
その通りよ！　
タコってやつぁ真水が大の苦手なんだ！
こりゃあ天の助けだぜっ！

text_block_list.name: Pecorine
text_block_list.text: I-I see...! So now's our chance to save them both!? In that case... TAAAAAAAAHHH!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
な、
なるほど……！
じゃあ今が、
二人を助けるチャンスですね！？
それなら……
たあああっ！！

text_block_list.name: Monster
text_block_list.text: Gyaoooooo!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──ギャオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: カズマサ
text_block_list.text:
ぜぇ……
助かったあぁぁ……！！
text_block_list.orig_text:
ぜぇ……
助かったあぁぁ……！！

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: U-Ugh... That was disgusting...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
う、
ううう……
気持ち悪かったわ……！

text_block_list.name: Kokkoro
text_block_list.text: It looks like neither of them is hurt... But still... why did it suddenly start raining?
text_block_list.orig_text:
二人とも
お怪我はなさそうですね……
それにしても……
どうして突然、
雨が降り出したのでしょう？

text_block_list.name: Rain Spirit
text_block_list.text: Everyone! Are you okay?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
みんなー！　
大丈夫～っ！？

text_block_list.name: Pecorine
text_block_list.text: Ah! You're the Rain Spirit from back then! And there's the Sun Spirit too! So was this thanks to your powers?
text_block_list.orig_text:
あっ！　
あなたは、
アメきちさんっ！
それに、
ハレきちさんも！
もしかして今の、
二人の力ですか？

text_block_list.name: Sun Spirit
text_block_list.text: Yeah! That rain just now was caused by the Rain Spirit! She's amazing!
text_block_list.orig_text:
うんっ！
さっきの雨は、
アメきちが降らせたんだよっ！
アメきちすごいすごーい！

text_block_list.name: Rain Spirit
text_block_list.text: Ehehe. I can't summon clouds here, so I'm just using the magic inside my body to make it rain a little. That's why I think it'll stop soon...
text_block_list.orig_text:
えへへ。
ここじゃ
雲を呼んだりはできないから、
わたしの体の中にある魔力で、
ちょっと
水を降らせてるだけ。
そういうわけで、
すぐにやんじゃうと思うけど……

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: No, you've helped at just the right time...! Thank you so much.
text_block_list.orig_text:
いいえ、
じゅうぶん助かったわ……！
本当にありがとう。

text_block_list.name: Pecorine
text_block_list.text: Yeah, yeah♪ Thanks to you, we were able to rescue the two of them safely, and now all that's left is to defeat that monster!
text_block_list.orig_text:
うんうん♪
おかげで無事に二人を助けられたことですし、
あとは魔物を倒すだけですっ！

text_block_list.name: Kazumasa
text_block_list.text: If that's yar intention, let me pitch in to help! I'll give this thing a taste of my sea cracker...
text_block_list.orig_text:
そういうことなら任しとけっ！
いっちょオレの
シークラッカーを
お見舞いしてや……

text_block_list.name: Kazumasa
text_block_list.text: ...Aaaah~!?

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: What? What's wrong with you this time? Don't tell me you forgot your sea crackers?
text_block_list.orig_text:
何？　
今度はどうしたのよ。
まさかシークラッカーを忘れたとかいうんじゃないでしょうね？

text_block_list.name: Kazumasa
text_block_list.text: No, I have some with me...! The only problem is... because of those wriggly things, THEY'RE ALL WET!!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
いや、
シークラッカーはある……！
ただ問題は……
あいつのにゅるにゅるのせいで、
濡れちまったーっ！！

text_block_list.name: Pecorine
text_block_list.text: U-Uwah... Then they can't be used. It'd have been reassuring if we had atleast one, I guess...
text_block_list.orig_text:
わ、
わあ……
じゃあ使えないですね。
あったら心強かったんですけど……

text_block_list.name: Kazumasa
text_block_list.text: It's okay! I'll dry them now, so just hold on for a bit! *Phew, phew!*
text_block_list.orig_text:
大丈夫だ！
今乾かすから、
ちーっと場ァつないでおいてくれっ！
ふーっ、
ふーっ！

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: H-He's trying to dry them with his breath... I wonder how long that will take? It seems like it would be faster to come up with a different plan...
text_block_list.orig_text:
い、
息で乾かそうとしてる……
どれくらい時間がかかるのかしら？
別の作戦考えたほうが早そうだけど……

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: Sheffy... best to wait on that without expecting much. But more importantly! Before the rain that the Rain Spirit has made come down stops, let's beat that squid to a pulp!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
シェフィ……
あれは期待しないで待つくらいがちょうどいいの。
それよりも！　
アメきちが降らせてくれた雨がやまないうちに、
あいつをギッタギッタにしちゃいましょうっ！！
